title: exo-FISH: Protocol for detecting DNA breaks in repetitive regions of mammalian genomes
protocol: Treat cells cultured in 10-cm dishes with 5 μM S-trityl-L-cysteine (STLC) in complete media for >5 h to enrich for mitotic cells.
Aspirate 90% of the remaining media.
Perform mitotic shake-off to dislodge mitotic cells.
Collect supernatant in a 15-mL conical tube.
Wash plate(s) with PBS to collect any remaining mitotic cells.
Add washed cells to 15-mL conical tube.
Centrifuge for 4 minutes at 500 xg at room temperature.
Aspirate media and resuspend pellet in 1 mL of PBS.
Count cells for each experimental condition.
Wash pellets in PBS, diluting to approximately 1 million cells per 1 mL of PBS.
Move 200 μL cell suspension to a fresh 15-mL tube (approximately 200 K cells).
Gradually add approximately 10 mL of 0.56% KCl to the side of the tube.
Invert tube gently four times to mix well.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Centrifuge samples for 5 minutes at 300 × g.
Prepare fresh 3:1 MeOH:AA Fixative Solution.
Aspirate the supernatant, leaving approximately 100 μL liquid.
Pipette up and down very gently to resuspend cell pellet.
Gradually add 1 mL fixative (3:1 MeOH:AA) dropwise on the side of the tube using a P1000 micropipette while gently shaking the tube.
Gently tap the tube to mix thoroughly.
Add an additional 9 mL 3:1 MeOH:AA, making a total volume of 10 mL per 200 K cells, while gently shaking the tube.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking shaker at low speed.
Centrifuge samples for 5 minutes at 300 × g.
Aspirate the supernatant, leaving approximately 100 μL liquid per 200 K cells.
Pipette up and down very gently to resuspend cell pellet.
Drop 10 μL of cells (such that approximately 20 K cells are dropped per slide) onto glass slides on to the middle of a 15 μL ddH2O drop.
Make two well-separated spreads per slide for different experimental conditions.
Inspect slides with a light microscope to ensure consistent cell densities and distributions between experimental conditions.
Discard aberrant slides.
Dry slides overnight (12–24 h) at room temperature (20°C–25°C), protected from light.
Perform all subsequent steps while protected from light.
Rehydrate slides in PBS for 5 min at room temperature in Coplin jars.
Dab slide edges on tissues to remove excess PBS.
Place slides with cells facing upwards on parafilm.
Gently add 500 μL of 0.5 mg/mL RNaseA in PBS dropwise across the slide.
Cover the slide with a parafilm strip.
Incubate at 37°C for 10 min in a humidified incubation chamber.
Wash slides in PBS for 5 min at room temperature in Coplin jars placed on a rocking platform shaker set to low speed.
Dab slide edges on tissues to remove excess PBS.
Dry the bottom of the slides to remove any moisture.
Place slides with cells facing upwards on fresh parafilm.
Add 200 μL 1× CutSmart containing either 0 or 1 total units BsmAI or Nt.BsmAI to each slide.
Cover with a parafilm strip, ensuring no liquid spillover, equal distribution across the slide, and no bubble formation.
Incubate at 37°C for 60 min in a humidified incubation chamber.
Wash slides in PBS for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) in coplin jars on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Dab slide edges on tissues to remove excess PBS.
Dry the bottom of the slides to remove any moisture.
Place slides with cells facing upwards on fresh parafilm.
Add 200 μL of 0 mU/μL ExoIII solution to each control slide.
Add 200 μL of 200 mU/μL ExoIII solution to each experimental slide.
Cover each slide with a parafilm strip, ensuring no liquid spillover and equal distribution across the slide.
Incubate slides at 37°C for 30 min in a humidified incubation chamber.
Wash slides in PBS for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Wash slides in 70% EtOH for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Wash slides in 95% EtOH for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Wash slides in 100% EtOH for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Air dry slides at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for at least 1 h.
Add 200 μL FISH Probe Solution (1:200 of stock, diluted in Hybridization Solution) to dried slides.
Cover the slide with a parafilm strip ensuring no liquid spillover, equal distribution across the slide, and no bubble formation.
Incubate for 1.5 h in the dark at room temperature (20°C–25°C) in a humidified incubation chamber.
Transfer slides to coplin jars and wash in Hybridization Wash Buffer #1 for 15 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Transfer slides to coplin jars containing Hybridization Wash Buffer #2 and wash for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Wash slides in Hybridization Wash Buffer #2 containing 0.5 μg/mL DAPI for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Wash slides in Hybridization Wash Buffer #2 for 5 min at room temperature on a rocking platform shaker at low speed.
Wash slides in 70% ethanol for 5 min.
Wash slides in 95% ethanol for 5 min.
Wash slides in 100% ethanol for 5 min.
Air dry slides until no liquid remains on the slide surface.
Cover glass slides with ProLong Gold Antifade Mounting media using approximately 30 μL.
Wait for mounting media to dry for at least 3 hours before proceeding to imaging.
Take images throughout the slide to account for local differences in FISH signal intensities.
Avoid imaging aggregates due to their abnormal FISH staining patterns.
Select cells by DAPI staining.
Image at least 30 cells per condition.
Capture 2–5 cells per image at 60×–100× magnification.
Take approximately 10 images from throughout the slide for each condition.
Set laser settings such that there is no saturation in any of the channels or conditions.
